disposition.note: Classes from Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5, rows DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020: identifiers Not personal, amounts and dates Customer data.

edits.old: **No personal data.** The rows this story writes carry identifiers, amounts, a code and a rule version.
edits.new: **Personal data.** The rows this story writes carry identifiers, amounts, a code and a rule version: the identifiers are classed Not personal, and the amounts, dates and GL keys are classed Customer data (Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5, DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020; section 17).

edits.old: - The decision is recorded before the change and the records and the updates commit together; a build that writes the rows first fails the review (DP-03).
edits.new:
- The decision is recorded before the change and the records and the updates commit together; a build that writes the rows first fails the review (DP-03).
- Personal-data classes of the write-off fields (Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5): `id`, `case_id` and `decision_log_id` (DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-012) are Not personal; `amount`, `tax_criteria_met`, `committee_date`, `posted_date`, `responsibility_center`, `cost_center`, `gl_product` and `recovered_after` (DF-FIN-013 to DF-FIN-020) are classed Customer data and are held as a code, an amount or a date only, never beside a direct identifier.
